options.source:
# The default champion type. Requires a restart to apply.
  default: 'zombie'
  zombie:
    name: 'Equipment'
    cost: "(lvl + 1) * 100"
    max-level: 5
    # Do not set the maximum health in the base. The health upgrade scaling will override it.
    base:
      # If you have mythicmobs installed you can do this:
      # mythicmob: <type>
      # The level of the mm mob is the same as the equipment's upgrade level.
      type: ZOMBIE
      baby: false
      name: "&c%kingdoms_kingdom_name% {$s}Champion"
    levels:
      1:
        equipment:
          main-hand:
            item:
              material: WOODEN_SWORD
          helmet:
            item:
              material: LEATHER_HELMET
          chestplate:
            item:
              material: LEATHER_CHESTPLATE
          leggings:
            item:
              material: LEATHER_LEGGINGS
          boots:
            item:
              material: LEATHER_BOOTS
      2:
        equipment:
          main-hand:
            item:
              material: STONE_SWORD
              enchants:
                KNOCKBACK: 1
          helmet:
            item:
              material: CHAINMAIL_HELMET
          chestplate:
            item:
              material: CHAINMAIL_CHESTPLATE
          leggings:
            item:
              material: CHAINMAIL_LEGGINGS
          boots:
            item:
              material: CHAINMAIL_BOOTS
      3:
        equipment:
          main-hand:
            item:
              material: GOLDEN_SWORD
              enchants:
                KNOCKBACK: 2
                FIRE_ASPECT: 1
          helmet:
            item:
              material: GOLDEN_HELMET
          chestplate:
            item:
              material: GOLDEN_CHESTPLATE
          leggings:
            item:
              material: GOLDEN_LEGGINGS
          boots:
            item:
              material: GOLDEN_BOOTS
      4:
        equipment:
          main-hand:
            item:
              material: IRON_SWORD
              enchants:
                KNOCKBACK: 2
                FIRE_ASPECT: 2
          helmet:
            item:
              material: IRON_HELMET
          chestplate:
            item:
              material: IRON_CHESTPLATE
          leggings:
            item:
              material: IRON_LEGGINGS
          boots:
            item:
              material: IRON_BOOTS
      5:
        equipment:
          main-hand:
            item:
              material: DIAMOND_SWORD
              enchants:
                KNOCKBACK: 2
                FIRE_ASPECT: 2
                SHARPNESS: 3
          helmet:
            item:
              material: DIAMOND_HELMET
          chestplate:
            item:
              material: DIAMOND_CHESTPLATE
          leggings:
            item:
              material: DIAMOND_LEGGINGS
          boots:
            item:
              material: DIAMOND_BOOTS
  skeleton:
    name: 'Equipment'
    cost: "(lvl + 1) * 100"
    max-level: 5
    base:
      type: SKELETON
      baby: false
      name: "&c%kingdoms_kingdom_name% {$s}Champion"
    levels:
      1:

          chestplate:
            item:
              material: LEATHER_CHESTPLATE
          leggings:
            item:
              material: LEATHER_LEGGINGS
          boots:
            item:
              material: LEATHER_BOOTS
      2:
        equipment:
          main-hand:
            item:
              material: BOW
              enchants:
                POWER: 2
                PUNCH: 1
          helmet:

              material: CHAINMAIL_HELMET
          chestplate:

              material: CHAINMAIL_CHESTPLATE
          leggings:
            item:
              material: CHAINMAIL_LEGGINGS
          boots:
            item:
              material: CHAINMAIL_BOOTS
      3:
        equipment:
          main-hand:
            item:
              material: BOW
              enchants:
                POWER: 3
                PUNCH: 2
          helmet:
            item:
              material: GOLDEN_HELMET
          chestplate:
            item:
              material: GOLDEN_CHESTPLATE
          leggings:
            item:
              material: GOLDEN_LEGGINGS
          boots:
            item:
              material: GOLDEN_BOOTS
      4:
        equipment:
          main-hand:
            item:
              material: BOW
              enchants:
                POWER: 4
                PUNCH: 2
                FLAME: 1
          helmet:
            item:
              material: IRON_HELMET
          chestplate:

              material: IRON_CHESTPLATE

      5:
